lead: Sidharth Shukla was an Indian model, born on 12 December 1980 in Mumbai.
He died on 2 September 2021 in Mumbai at the age of 40.

He is associated with work such as Balika Vadhu, Dil Se Dil Tak and Humpty Sharma Ki Dulhania and has been recognised with Stardust Award for Breakthrough Performance – Male and Boroplus Gold Award for Best Actor in a Lead Role.
